"The circle of spores is a bit of a black sheep for other reasons as well. Most druidic circles tend to deal with the brighter and more commonly accepted aspects of nature. We value the scavengers. When a noble beast falls, we believe the best way to honor its life is not to immortalize it with magic, but to use it as fuel for life anew.
